# Cross-Backend Translation Showcase

Live translations of high-level C# constructs generated directly by the latest `polypiler translate` across every supported backend and target dialect. Dialects are grouped under their parent backend so you can compare how features lower across versions (such as `es5` vs `es2022`, `net2.0` vs `net10.0`, `py3.8` vs `py3.14`, `perl/5.6` vs `perl/5`, `cpp/cpp17` vs `cpp/cpp23`, `cmd` vs `dos622`, `visualbasic/vb6` vs `visualbasic/vba7-64` vs `vbnet/vb16.9`, `jvm/8` vs `jvm/21`, `msil/net8` vs `msil/net10`, `go1.18` vs `go1.27`, and `kotlin2.0` vs `kotlin2.4-jvm21`). Structurally identical dialect outputs under the same backend are collapsed together while every distinct lowering is shown verbatim. Binary targets (`.NET MSIL`, `JVM bytecode`) are disassembled from the real emitted `.dll` and `.jar` artifacts into readable assembler-like text mnemonics. Constructs not yet implemented report their exact `PLY####` diagnostic rather than fabricating code.

Regenerate locally with:

```bash
dotnet build Polypiler.Cli/Polypiler.Cli.csproj -c Release
dotnet run --project Polypiler.Tooling/Polypiler.Tooling.csproj -c Release -- report showcase
```

## Operators, Bitwise & Checked Arithmetic

Wrapping vs checked integer arithmetic, bitwise masks, shifts, and bit rotation. Source: [`01-operators-and-checked.cs`](showcase/01-operators-and-checked.cs).

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

public static class OperatorsShowcase {
  public static uint Mix(uint value, int shift) {
    uint rotated = BitOperations.RotateLeft(value, shift);
    return unchecked((rotated ^ 0x9E3779B9u) * 0x85EBCA6Bu);
  }

  public static int SafeAdd(int a, int b) => checked(a + b);
}
```

```rust
pub fn mix(value: u32, shift: i32) -> u32 {
    let rotated: u32 = value.rotate_left(shift as u32);
    (rotated ^ 2654435769).wrapping_mul(2246822507)
}

pub fn safe_add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    a.checked_add(b).expect("IntegerOverflow")
}
```

```cpp
#include "operators_showcase.hpp"
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>

namespace operators_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename T>
T ply_checked_add(T a, T b) {
  if constexpr (std::is_signed_v<T>) {
    if ((b > 0 && a > std::numeric_limits<T>::max() - b) ||
        (b < 0 && a < std::numeric_limits<T>::min() - b))
      throw std::overflow_error("integer overflow");
    using U = std::make_unsigned_t<T>;
    return static_cast<T>(static_cast<U>(a) + static_cast<U>(b));
  } else {
    if (a > std::numeric_limits<T>::max() - b)
      throw std::overflow_error("integer overflow");
    return static_cast<T>(a + b);
  }
}

template <typename T>
T ply_rotl(T value, std::int32_t count) {
  using U = std::make_unsigned_t<T>;
  constexpr unsigned bits = static_cast<unsigned>(sizeof(T) * 8);
  const unsigned s = static_cast<unsigned>(count) & (bits - 1u);
  const U u = static_cast<U>(value);
  return s == 0u ? value : static_cast<T>((u << s) | (u >> (bits - s)));
}

} // namespace

std::uint32_t mix(std::uint32_t value, std::int32_t shift) {
  std::uint32_t rotated = ply_rotl<std::uint32_t>(value, shift);
  return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rotated) ^ static_cast<std::uint32_t>(2654435769u))) * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(2246822507u));
}

std::int32_t safe_add(std::int32_t a, std::int32_t b) {
  return ply_checked_add<std::int32_t>(a, b);
}

} // namespace operators_showcase
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_u32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  ply_u32 = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
End Function

Function ply_mul32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim ua, ub, al, ah, bl, bh, lo, md
  ua = ply_u32(a)
  ub = ply_u32(b)
  al = ua - Int(ua / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ah = Int(ua / 65536.0)
  bl = ub - Int(ub / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  bh = Int(ub / 65536.0)
  lo = al * bl
  md = ah * bl + al * bh
  md = md - Int(md / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ply_mul32 = ply_i32(lo + md * 65536.0)
End Function

Function ply_or32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  ply_or32 = ply_i32(a) Or ply_i32(b)
End Function

Function ply_xor32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  ply_xor32 = ply_i32(a) Xor ply_i32(b)
End Function

Function ply_shl32(ByVal a, ByVal n)
  Dim s, p, u
  s = ply_i32(n) And 31
  If s = 0 Then
    ply_shl32 = ply_i32(a)
    Exit Function
  End If
  p = 2.0 ^ (32 - s)
  u = ply_u32(a)
  u = u - Int(u / p) * p
  ply_shl32 = ply_i32(u * (2.0 ^ s))
End Function

Function ply_ushr32(ByVal a, ByVal n)
  Dim s
  s = ply_i32(n) And 31
  If s = 0 Then
    ply_ushr32 = ply_u32(a)
    Exit Function
  End If
  ply_ushr32 = Int(ply_u32(a) / (2.0 ^ s))
End Function

Function ply_chk_range(ByVal v, ByVal lo, ByVal hi)
  Dim d
  d = CDbl(v)
  If d < lo Or d > hi Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1002, "OverflowException", "Arithmetic operation resulted in an overflow."
  ply_chk_range = d
End Function

Function ply_rotl32(ByVal x, ByVal n, ByVal isSigned)
  Dim s, r
  s = ply_i32(n) And 31
  If s = 0 Then
    If isSigned Then ply_rotl32 = ply_i32(x) Else ply_rotl32 = ply_u32(x)
    Exit Function
  End If
  r = ply_or32(ply_shl32(x, s), ply_ushr32(x, 32 - s))
  If isSigned Then ply_rotl32 = r Else ply_rotl32 = ply_u32(r)
End Function


Function Mix(ByVal value, ByVal shift)

  Mix = ply_u32(ply_mul32(ply_u32(ply_xor32(rotated, CDbl(2654435769.0))), CDbl(2246822507.0)))
  Exit Function
End Function

Function SafeAdd(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  SafeAdd = ply_i32(ply_chk_range(CDbl(a) + CDbl(b), -2147483648.0, 2147483647.0))
```

## Recursion

Direct recursive Euclidean GCD and recursive Fibonacci with base cases. Source: [`02-recursion.cs`](showcase/02-recursion.cs).

```csharp
public static class RecursionShowcase {
  public static int Gcd(int a, int b) {
    if (b == 0)
      return a < 0 ? -a : a;
    return Gcd(b, a % b);
  }

  public static int Fib(int n) {
    if (n <= 1)
      return n;
    return Fib(n - 1) + Fib(n - 2);
  }
}
```

```rust
fn ply_rem_i32(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    if b == 0 {
        panic!("DivideByZero");
    }
    a.checked_rem(b).expect("IntegerOverflow")
}

pub fn gcd(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    if b == 0 {
        return a.wrapping_abs();
    }
    gcd(b, ply_rem_i32(a, b))
}

pub fn fib(n: i32) -> i32 {
    if n <= 1 {
        return n;
    }
    fib(n.wrapping_sub(1)).wrapping_add(fib(n.wrapping_sub(2)))
}
```

```perl
sub gcd {

    @_ == 2 or Carp::croak('usage: gcd($a_, $b_)');

}

sub fib {
    use integer;
    @_ == 1 or Carp::croak('usage: fib($n)');
    my ($n) = @_;
    return $n if $n <= 1;
    return (((((fib(($n - 1)) + fib(($n - 2)))) & 0xFFFFFFFF) ^ 0x80000000) - 0x80000000);
}

1;
```

```cpp
#include "recursion_showcase.hpp"
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>

namespace recursion_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename T>
T ply_rem(T a, T b) {
  if (b == 0)
    throw std::domain_error("divide by zero");
  if constexpr (std::is_signed_v<T>) {
    if (a == std::numeric_limits<T>::min() && b == static_cast<T>(-1))
      throw std::overflow_error("integer overflow");
  }
  return static_cast<T>(a % b);
}

} // namespace

std::int32_t gcd(std::int32_t a, std::int32_t b) {
  if ((b == 0)) {
    return ((a < 0) ? static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(0) - static_cast<std::uint32_t>(a)) : a);
  }
  return gcd(b, ply_rem<std::int32_t>(a, b));
}

std::int32_t fib(std::int32_t n) {
  if ((n <= 1)) {
    return n;
  }
  return static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(fib(static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(n) - static_cast<std::uint32_t>(1)))) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(fib(static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(n) - static_cast<std::uint32_t>(2)))));
}

} // namespace recursion_showcase
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_rem32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  If b = 0 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1001, "DivideByZeroException", "Attempted to divide by zero."
  If CDbl(a) = -2147483648.0 And b = -1 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1002, "OverflowException", "Arithmetic operation resulted in an overflow."
  ply_rem32 = CLng(CDbl(a) - Fix(CDbl(a) / CDbl(b)) * CDbl(b))
End Function


Function Gcd(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim value, absWrap32, ply_c1
  If ((b) = (0)) Then
    If ((a) < (0)) Then
      ply_c1 = ply_i32((-CDbl(a)))
    Else
      ply_c1 = a
    End If
    Gcd = ply_c1
    Exit Function
  End If
  Gcd = Gcd(b, ply_rem32(a, b))
  Exit Function
End Function

Function Fib(ByVal n)
  If ((n) <= (1)) Then
    Fib = n
    Exit Function
  End If
  Fib = ply_i32(CDbl(Fib(ply_i32(CDbl(n) - CDbl(1)))) + CDbl(Fib(ply_i32(CDbl(n) - CDbl(2)))))
  Exit Function
End Function
```

```vb
Private Function PlyWrap32(ByVal d As Double) As Long
```

```csharp
public sealed class Accumulator {
  private int _total;

  public Accumulator() => this._total = 0;
  public Accumulator(int seed) => this._total = seed;

  public int Add(int value) {
    this._total += value;
    return this._total;
  }

  public int Add(int a, int b) {
    this._total += a + b;
    return this._total;
  }
}

public static class OverloadingShowcase {
  public static int Run(int seed, int x, int y) {
    var a = new Accumulator();
    var b = new Accumulator(seed);
    return a.Add(x) + b.Add(x, y);
  }
}
```

```rust
        this.init();
        this
    }

        this.init_2(seed);
        this
    }

        self.total = 0;
    }

    fn init_2(&mut self, seed: i32) {
        self.total = seed;
    }

    pub fn add(&mut self, value: i32) -> i32 {
        self.total = self.total.wrapping_add(value);
        self.total
    }

    pub fn add_2(&mut self, a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
        self.total = self.total.wrapping_add(a.wrapping_add(b));
        self.total
    }
}

pub fn run(seed: i32, x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut a: Accumulator = Accumulator::new();
    let mut b: Accumulator = Accumulator::new_2(seed);
```

```cpp
#include "overloading_showcase.hpp"
#include <stdexcept>

namespace overloading_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename T>
const std::shared_ptr<T>& ply_nonnull(const std::shared_ptr<T>& ptr) {
  if (!ptr)
    throw std::runtime_error("null reference");
  return ptr;
}

} // namespace

Accumulator::Accumulator() {
  this->total = 0;
}

Accumulator::Accumulator(std::int32_t seed) {
  this->total = seed;
}

std::int32_t Accumulator::add(std::int32_t value) {
  this->total = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(this->total) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value));
  return this->total;
}

std::int32_t Accumulator::add_2(std::int32_t a, std::int32_t b) {
  this->total = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(this->total) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(a) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b))));
  return this->total;
}

std::int32_t run(std::int32_t seed, std::int32_t x, std::int32_t y) {
  std::shared_ptr<Accumulator> a = std::make_shared<Accumulator>();
  std::shared_ptr<Accumulator> b = std::make_shared<Accumulator>(seed);
  return static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ply_nonnull(a)->add(x)) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ply_nonnull(b)->add_2(x, y)));
}

} // namespace overloading_showcase
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_chk_null(ByVal o)
  If o Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  Set ply_chk_null = o
End Function


Class Accumulator
  Public f__total
  Private Sub Class_Initialize()
    f__total = 0
  End Sub
  Public Function ply_is(ByVal t)
    ply_is = (t = "Accumulator")
  End Function
  Public Function Add(ByVal p_0)
    Add = Accumulator_Add(Me, p_0)
  End Function
  Public Function Add_2(ByVal p_0, ByVal p_1)
    Add_2 = Accumulator_Add2(Me, p_0, p_1)
  End Function
End Class

Function new_Accumulator_0()

  Set inst = New Accumulator
  Call Accumulator_ctor(inst)
  Set new_Accumulator_0 = inst
End Function

Function new_Accumulator_1(ByVal p_0)

  Set inst = New Accumulator
  Call Accumulator_ctor2(inst, p_0)
  Set new_Accumulator_1 = inst
End Function


Function Run(ByVal seed, ByVal x, ByVal y)
  Dim a, b, ply_r1, ply_r2, ply_l3
  Set a = new_Accumulator_0()
  Set b = new_Accumulator_1(seed)
  Set ply_r1 = ply_chk_null(a)
  ply_l3 = ply_r1.Add(x)
  Set ply_r2 = ply_chk_null(b)
  Run = ply_i32(CDbl(ply_l3) + CDbl(ply_r2.Add_2(x, y)))

End Function

Function Accumulator_Add(ByVal this, ByVal value)
  Dim ply_o1, ply_o2, ply_o3
  Set ply_o1 = ply_chk_null(this)
  Set ply_o2 = ply_chk_null(this)
  ply_o1.f__total = ply_i32(CDbl(ply_o2.f__total) + CDbl(value))
  Set ply_o3 = ply_chk_null(this)
  Accumulator_Add = ply_o3.f__total
  Exit Function
End Function

Function Accumulator_Add2(ByVal this, ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim ply_o1, ply_o2, ply_o3
  Set ply_o1 = ply_chk_null(this)
  Set ply_o2 = ply_chk_null(this)
  ply_o1.f__total = ply_i32(CDbl(ply_o2.f__total) + CDbl(ply_i32(CDbl(a) + CDbl(b))))
  Set ply_o3 = ply_chk_null(this)
  Accumulator_Add2 = ply_o3.f__total
  Exit Function
End Function

  Set ply_o1 = ply_chk_null(this)
  ply_o1.f__total = 0
End Sub

Sub Accumulator_ctor2(ByVal this, ByVal seed)
  Dim ply_o1
  Set ply_o1 = ply_chk_null(this)
  ply_o1.f__total = seed
End Sub
```

## Structs & Value Records

Value-type readonly record struct with constructor, copy semantics, and structural equality. Source: [`04-structs-and-records.cs`](showcase/04-structs-and-records.cs).

```csharp
public readonly record struct Vec2(int X, int Y);

public struct MutablePair {
  public int First;
  public int Second;
}

public static class StructsAndRecordsShowcase {
  public static int Dot(Vec2 a, Vec2 b) => a.X * b.X + a.Y * b.Y;

  public static bool AreEqual(int x, int y) {
    var left = new Vec2(x, y);
    var right = new Vec2(x, y);
    return left == right;
  }

  public static int CopyValue(int x) {
    var original = new MutablePair { First = x, Second = 10 };
    var copy = original;
    copy.First = x + 1;
    return original.First * 100 + copy.First;
  }
}
```

```javascript
  return left.X === right.X && left.Y === right.Y;
}

// CopyValue(x: number): number
export function CopyValue(x) {
  let original = { First: 0, Second: 0 };
  original.First = x;
  original.Second = 10;
  let copy = { First: original.First, Second: original.Second };
  copy.First = (x + 1) | 0;
  return (Math.imul(original.First, 100) + copy.First) | 0;
}
```

```rust
pub struct Vec2 {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

pub struct MutablePair {
    pub first: i32,
    pub second: i32,
}

pub fn dot(a: Vec2, b: Vec2) -> i32 {
    a.x.wrapping_mul(b.x).wrapping_add(a.y.wrapping_mul(b.y))
}

pub fn are_equal(x: i32, y: i32) -> bool {
    let left: Vec2 = Vec2 { x, y };
    let right: Vec2 = Vec2 { x, y };
    left == right
}

pub fn copy_value(x: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut original: MutablePair = MutablePair::default();
    original.first = x;
    original.second = 10;
    let mut copy: MutablePair = original;
    copy.first = x.wrapping_add(1);
    original.first.wrapping_mul(100).wrapping_add(copy.first)
```

```cpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace structs_and_records_showcase {

struct Vec2 {
  std::int32_t x{};
  std::int32_t y{};

  bool operator==(const Vec2& other) const {
    return (this->x == other.x) && (this->y == other.y);
  }
  bool operator!=(const Vec2& other) const { return !(*this == other); }
};

struct MutablePair {
  std::int32_t first{};
  std::int32_t second{};

  bool operator==(const MutablePair& other) const {
    return (this->first == other.first) && (this->second == other.second);
  }
  bool operator!=(const MutablePair& other) const { return !(*this == other); }
};

std::int32_t dot(Vec2 a, Vec2 b);
bool are_equal(std::int32_t x, std::int32_t y);
std::int32_t copy_value(std::int32_t x);
```

```vbscript
Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)

Function ply_u32(ByVal x)

  ply_u32 = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
End Function

Function ply_mul32(ByVal a, ByVal b)

  ua = ply_u32(a)
  ub = ply_u32(b)
  al = ua - Int(ua / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ah = Int(ua / 65536.0)
  bl = ub - Int(ub / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  bh = Int(ub / 65536.0)
  lo = al * bl
  md = ah * bl + al * bh
  md = md - Int(md / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ply_mul32 = ply_i32(lo + md * 65536.0)
End Function


Class Vec2
  Public X
  Public Y

    Y = 0
  End Sub

    c.Y = Y
    Set ply_clone = c
  End Function
  Public Function ply_equals(ByVal other)

    If Y <> other.Y Then ply_equals = False : Exit Function
    ply_equals = True

    If Second_v <> other.Second_v Then ply_equals = False : Exit Function
    ply_equals = True
  End Function
End Class

  Exit Function
```

```csharp
public sealed class Meter {
  public int Count { get; private set; }
  public int Scale { get; init; }
  public int Total => this.Count * this.Scale;

  public Meter(int scale) => this.Scale = scale;

  public void Increment(int by) => this.Count += by;
}

public sealed record PointRecord(int X, int Y);

public static class ClassesShowcase {
  public static int Measure(int scale, int steps) {
    var meter = new Meter(scale);
    meter.Increment(steps);
    var p1 = new PointRecord(meter.Count, meter.Total);
    var p2 = new PointRecord(meter.Count, meter.Total);
    return p1 == p2 ? meter.Total : -1;
  }
}
```

```rust
use std::cell::Cell;
use std::rc::Rc;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Meter {
    count: i32,
    scale: i32,
}

impl Meter {
    pub fn new(scale: i32) -> Self {
        let mut this = Self::default();
        this.init(scale);
        this
    }

    fn init(&mut self, scale: i32) {
        self.scale = scale;
    }

    pub fn total(&self) -> i32 {
        self.count.wrapping_mul(self.scale)
    }

    pub fn increment(&mut self, by: i32) {
        self.count = self.count.wrapping_add(by);
    }
}

#[derive(Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct PointRecord {
    x: Cell<i32>,
    y: Cell<i32>,
}

impl PointRecord {
    pub fn new(x: i32, y: i32) -> Rc<Self> {
        let this = Rc::new(Self::default());
        this.init(x, y);
        this
    }

    fn init(&self, x: i32, y: i32) {
        self.x.set(x);
        self.y.set(y);
    }
}

pub fn measure(scale: i32, steps: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut meter: Meter = Meter::new(scale);
    meter.increment(steps);
    let p1: Rc<PointRecord> = PointRecord::new(meter.count, meter.total());
    let p2: Rc<PointRecord> = PointRecord::new(meter.count, meter.total());
    if p1 == p2 { meter.total() } else { -1 }
}
```

```rust
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicI32;
use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;

static WEIGHTS: [i32; 4] = [3, 5, 11, 17];

static COUNTER: AtomicI32 = AtomicI32::new(1);

pub fn next_weighted(index: i32) -> i32 {
    let slot: i32 = index & 3;
    let value: i32 = COUNTER
        .load(Ordering::Relaxed)
        .wrapping_mul(WEIGHTS[slot as usize])
        .wrapping_add(7);
    COUNTER.store(
        COUNTER.load(Ordering::Relaxed).wrapping_add(1),
        Ordering::Relaxed,
    );
    value
}
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Const Salt = 7

Dim Weights
Dim g__counter

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_u32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  ply_u32 = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
End Function

Function ply_mul32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim ua, ub, al, ah, bl, bh, lo, md
  ua = ply_u32(a)
  ub = ply_u32(b)
  al = ua - Int(ua / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ah = Int(ua / 65536.0)
  bl = ub - Int(ub / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  bh = Int(ub / 65536.0)
  lo = al * bl
  md = ah * bl + al * bh
  md = md - Int(md / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ply_mul32 = ply_i32(lo + md * 65536.0)
End Function

Function ply_and32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  ply_and32 = ply_i32(a) And ply_i32(b)
End Function

Sub ply_chk_idx(ByRef a, ByVal i)
  If IsNull(a) Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  If i < 0 Or i > UBound(a) Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1003, "IndexOutOfRangeException", "Index was outside the bounds of the array."
End Sub


Function NextWeighted(ByVal index)
  Dim slot, value, ply_l1
  slot = ply_and32(index, 3)
  ply_l1 = g__counter
  Call ply_chk_idx(Weights, slot)
  value = ply_i32(CDbl(ply_mul32(ply_l1, Weights(slot))) + CDbl(7))
  g__counter = ply_i32(CDbl(g__counter) + CDbl(1))
  NextWeighted = value
  Exit Function
End Function

Sub ply_init()
  Weights = Array(3, 5, 11, 17)
  g__counter = 1
End Sub
Call ply_init()
```

```vb
Private Const Salt As Long = 7
Private Weights() As Long

Private PlyReady As Boolean

Public Function NextWeighted(ByVal index As Long) As Long
    Dim slot As Long
    Dim value As Long
    If Not PlyReady Then
        PlyInit
    End If
    slot = index And 3
    value = PlyAdd32(PlyMul32(counter, Weights(slot)), 7)
    counter = PlyAdd32(counter, 1)
    NextWeighted = value
End Function

Private Sub PlyInit()
    ReDim Weights(0 To 3)
    Weights(0) = 3
    Weights(1) = 5
    Weights(2) = 11
    Weights(3) = 17
    counter = 1
    PlyReady = True
End Sub

Private Function PlyWrap32(ByVal d As Double) As Long
    d = d - Int(d / 4294967296#) * 4294967296#
    If d >= 2147483648# Then
        d = d - 4294967296#
    End If
    PlyWrap32 = CLng(d)
End Function

Private Function PlyU32(ByVal a As Long) As Double
    If a < 0 Then
        PlyU32 = CDbl(a) + 4294967296#
    Else
        PlyU32 = CDbl(a)
    End If
End Function

Private Function PlyAdd32(ByVal a As Long, ByVal b As Long) As Long
    PlyAdd32 = PlyWrap32(CDbl(a) + CDbl(b))
End Function

Private Function PlyMul32(ByVal a As Long, ByVal b As Long) As Long
    Dim ua As Double, ub As Double, al As Double, ah As Double, bl As Double, bh As Double, middle As Double
    ua = PlyU32(a)
    ub = PlyU32(b)
    ah = Int(ua / 65536#)
    al = ua - ah * 65536#
    bh = Int(ub / 65536#)
    bl = ub - bh * 65536#
    middle = ah * bl + al * bh
    middle = middle - Int(middle / 65536#) * 65536#
    PlyMul32 = PlyWrap32(al * bl + middle * 65536#)
End Function
```

## Inheritance, Virtual Dispatch & Interfaces

Single inheritance, abstract classes, virtual overrides, interface dispatch, and runtime type checks. Source: [`07-inheritance-and-interfaces.cs`](showcase/07-inheritance-and-interfaces.cs).

```csharp
public interface IScalable {
  int Area();
}

public abstract class Shape : IScalable {
  protected int Factor { get; }
  protected Shape(int factor) => this.Factor = factor;
  public abstract int Area();
}

public sealed class Rect : Shape {
  private readonly int _w;
  private readonly int _h;
  public Rect(int w, int h, int factor) : base(factor) {
    this._w = w;
    this._h = h;
  }
  public override int Area() => this._w * this._h * this.Factor;
}

public sealed class Square : Shape {
  private readonly int _side;
  public Square(int side) : base(1) => this._side = side;
  public override int Area() => this._side * this._side;
}

public static class InheritanceShowcase {
  public static int Measure(bool rect, int a, int b) {
    IScalable item;
    if (rect)
      item = new Rect(a, b, 2);
    else
      item = new Square(a);
```

```rust
use std::cell::Cell;
use std::rc::Rc;

pub trait PlyObject {
    fn is_square(&self) -> bool;

    fn into_square(self: Rc<Self>) -> Option<Rc<Square>>;
}

pub trait IScalable: PlyObject {
    fn area(&self) -> i32;
}

pub trait Shape: PlyObject + IScalable {
    fn field_factor(&self) -> &Cell<i32>;

    fn area(&self) -> i32;
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Rect {
    factor: Cell<i32>,
    w: Cell<i32>,
    h: Cell<i32>,
}

impl Rect {
    pub fn new(w: i32, h: i32, factor: i32) -> Rc<Self> {
        let this = Rc::new(Self::default());
        rect_ctor(&this, w, h, factor);
        this
    }
}

impl PlyObject for Rect {
    fn is_square(&self) -> bool {
        false
    }

    fn into_square(self: Rc<Self>) -> Option<Rc<Square>> {
        None
    }
}

impl Shape for Rect {
    fn field_factor(&self) -> &Cell<i32> {
        &self.factor
    }

    fn area(&self) -> i32 {
        rect_area(self)
    }
}

impl IScalable for Rect {
    fn area(&self) -> i32 {
        Shape::area(self)
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Square {
    factor: Cell<i32>,
    side: Cell<i32>,
}

impl Square {
    pub fn new(side: i32) -> Rc<Self> {
        let this = Rc::new(Self::default());
        square_ctor(&this, side);
        this
    }
}

impl PlyObject for Square {
    fn is_square(&self) -> bool {
        true
    }

    fn into_square(self: Rc<Self>) -> Option<Rc<Square>> {
        Some(self)
    }
}

impl Shape for Square {
    fn field_factor(&self) -> &Cell<i32> {
        &self.factor
    }

    fn area(&self) -> i32 {
        square_area(self)
    }
}

impl IScalable for Square {
    fn area(&self) -> i32 {
        Shape::area(self)
    }
}

fn ply_non_null<T>(value: &Option<T>) -> &T {
    value.as_ref().expect("NullReference")
}

pub fn measure(rect: bool, a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    let item: Option<Rc<dyn IScalable>> = if rect {
        Some(Rect::new(a, b, 2))
    } else {
        Some(Square::new(a))
    };
    let bonus: i32 = if item.as_deref().is_some_and(PlyObject::is_square) {
        1
    } else {
        0
    };
    IScalable::area(&**ply_non_null(&item)).wrapping_add(bonus)
}

pub fn shape_ctor<T: Shape + ?Sized>(this: &T, factor: i32) {
    Shape::field_factor(this).set(factor);
}

pub fn rect_area(this: &Rect) -> i32 {
    this.w
        .get()
        .wrapping_mul(this.h.get())
        .wrapping_mul(this.factor.get())
}

pub fn rect_ctor(this: &Rect, w: i32, h: i32, factor: i32) {
    shape_ctor(this, factor);
    this.w.set(w);
    this.h.set(h);
}

pub fn square_area(this: &Square) -> i32 {
    this.side.get().wrapping_mul(this.side.get())
}

pub fn square_ctor(this: &Square, side: i32) {
    shape_ctor(this, 1);
    this.side.set(side);
}
```

```cpp
#include "inheritance_showcase.hpp"
#include <stdexcept>

namespace inheritance_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename T>
const std::shared_ptr<T>& ply_nonnull(const std::shared_ptr<T>& ptr) {
  if (!ptr)
    throw std::runtime_error("null reference");
  return ptr;
}

} // namespace

Shape::Shape(std::int32_t factor) {
  this->factor = factor;
}

Rect::Rect(std::int32_t w, std::int32_t h, std::int32_t factor) : Shape(factor) {
  this->w = w;
  this->h = h;
}

std::int32_t Rect::area() {
  return static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(this->w) * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(this->h))) * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(this->factor));
}

Square::Square(std::int32_t side) : Shape(1) {
  this->side = side;
}

std::int32_t Square::area() {
  return static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(this->side) * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(this->side));
}

std::int32_t measure(bool rect, std::int32_t a, std::int32_t b) {
  std::shared_ptr<IScalable> item = nullptr;
  if (rect) {
    item = std::make_shared<Rect>(a, b, 2);
  } else {
    item = std::make_shared<Square>(a);
  }
  std::int32_t bonus = ((std::dynamic_pointer_cast<Square>(item) != nullptr) ? 1 : 0);
  return static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ply_nonnull(item)->area()) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(bonus));
}

} // namespace inheritance_showcase
```

```cpp
#pragma once

namespace inheritance_showcase {

public:
  virtual ~IScalable() = default;
  virtual std::int32_t area() = 0;
};

class Shape : public std::enable_shared_from_this<Shape>, public virtual IScalable {
public:

  virtual ~Shape() = default;
  explicit Shape(std::int32_t factor);
  virtual std::int32_t area() = 0;
};

class Rect : public Shape {
public:

  std::int32_t h{};

  Rect(std::int32_t w, std::int32_t h, std::int32_t factor);
  std::int32_t area() override;
};

class Square : public Shape {
public:
  std::int32_t side{};

  virtual ~Square() = default;
  explicit Square(std::int32_t side);
  std::int32_t area() override;
};

std::int32_t measure(bool rect, std::int32_t a, std::int32_t b);

} // namespace inheritance_showcase
```

```csharp
using System;

public sealed class Box<T> where T : struct {
  public T Value { get; set; }
  public Box(T initial) => this.Value = initial;
}

public static class GenericsShowcase {
  private static T Clamp<T>(T value, T min, T max) where T : IComparable<T> {
    if (value.CompareTo(min) < 0)
      return min;
    if (value.CompareTo(max) > 0)
      return max;
    return value;
  }

  public static long Run(int a, long b) {
    var intBox = new Box<int>(Clamp(a, 0, 100));
    var longBox = new Box<long>(Clamp(b, -50L, 50L));
    return intBox.Value + longBox.Value;
  }
}
```

```javascript
export class Box$i64 {
  Value = 0n;
  constructor(initial) {
    this.Value = initial;
  }
}

// Run(a: number, b: bigint): bigint
export function Run(a, b) {
  let intBox = new Box$i32(Clamp(a, 0, 100));
  let longBox = new Box$i64(Clamp(b, -50n, 50n));
  return BigInt.asIntN(64, BigInt(intBox.Value) + longBox.Value);
}

// Clamp(value: number | bigint, min: number | bigint, max: number | bigint): number
function Clamp(value, min, max) {
  if ($compare(value, min) < 0) {
    return min;
  }
  if ($compare(value, max) > 0) {
    return max;
  }
  return value;
}
```

**`generics_showcase.cpp`**

```cpp
#include "generics_showcase.hpp"
#include <cmath>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <type_traits>

namespace generics_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename T>
const std::shared_ptr<T>& ply_nonnull(const std::shared_ptr<T>& ptr) {
  if (!ptr)
    throw std::runtime_error("null reference");
  return ptr;
}

template <typename T>
std::int32_t ply_compare(const T& a, const T& b) {
  if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<T>) {
    if (a < b) return -1;
    if (a > b) return 1;
    if (a == b) return 0;
    return std::isnan(a) ? (std::isnan(b) ? 0 : -1) : 1;
  } else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, std::string>) {
    const int c = a.compare(b);
    return c < 0 ? -1 : (c > 0 ? 1 : 0);
  } else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, std::optional<std::string>>) {
    if (!a.has_value()) return b.has_value() ? -1 : 0;
    if (!b.has_value()) return 1;
    const int c = a->compare(*b);
    return c < 0 ? -1 : (c > 0 ? 1 : 0);
  } else if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T> && !std::is_same_v<T, bool> && sizeof(T) < 4) {
    return static_cast<std::int32_t>(a) - static_cast<std::int32_t>(b);
  } else {
    return a < b ? -1 : (a > b ? 1 : 0);
  }
}

} // namespace

static std::int32_t clamp_of_i32(std::int32_t, std::int32_t, std::int32_t);
static std::int64_t clamp_of_i64(std::int64_t, std::int64_t, std::int64_t);

BoxI32::BoxI32(std::int32_t initial) {
  this->value = initial;
}

BoxI64::BoxI64(std::int64_t initial) {
  this->value = initial;
}

static std::int32_t clamp_of_i32(std::int32_t value, std::int32_t min, std::int32_t max) {
  if ((ply_compare(value, min) < 0)) {
    return min;
  }
  if ((ply_compare(value, max) > 0)) {
    return max;
  }
  return value;
}

static std::int64_t clamp_of_i64(std::int64_t value, std::int64_t min, std::int64_t max) {
  if ((ply_compare(value, min) < 0)) {
    return min;
  }
  if ((ply_compare(value, max) > 0)) {
    return max;
  }
  return value;
}

std::int64_t run(std::int32_t a, std::int64_t b) {
  std::shared_ptr<BoxI32> int_box = std::make_shared<BoxI32>(clamp_of_i32(a, 0, 100));
  std::shared_ptr<BoxI64> long_box = std::make_shared<BoxI64>(clamp_of_i64(b, -50LL, 50LL));
  return static_cast<std::int64_t>(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(ply_nonnull(int_box)->value))) + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(ply_nonnull(long_box)->value));
}

} // namespace generics_showcase
```

```csharp
  public static int Run(int start, int step) {
    int acc = start;
    Func<int, int> bump = delta => {
      acc += delta;
      return acc;
    };

    int DoubleAcc() {
      acc *= 2;
      return acc;
    }

    int first = bump(step);
    int second = DoubleAcc();
    return first + second;
  }
}
```

```rust
use std::cell::Cell;
use std::rc::Rc;

pub fn run(start: i32, step: i32) -> i32 {
    let acc = Rc::new(Cell::new(start));
    let double_acc: Rc<dyn Fn() -> i32> = Rc::new({
        let acc = Rc::clone(&acc);
        move || {
            acc.set(acc.get().wrapping_mul(2));
            acc.get()
        }
    });
    let bump: Rc<dyn Fn(i32) -> i32> = Rc::new({
        let acc = Rc::clone(&acc);
        move |delta: i32| {
            acc.set(acc.get().wrapping_add(delta));
            acc.get()
        }
    });
    let first: i32 = bump(step);
    let second: i32 = double_acc();
    first.wrapping_add(second)
}
```

```cpp
#include "closures_showcase.hpp"
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace closures_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename F>
const F& ply_nonnull_fn(const F& fn) {
  if (!fn)
    throw std::runtime_error("null reference");
  return fn;
}

} // namespace

std::int32_t run(std::int32_t start, std::int32_t step) {
  std::function<std::int32_t()> double_acc = std::function<std::int32_t()>{};
  auto acc = std::make_shared<std::int32_t>(start);
  double_acc = [acc]() -> std::int32_t {
  (*acc) = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>((*acc)) * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(2));
  return (*acc);
};
  std::function<std::int32_t(std::int32_t)> bump = [acc](std::int32_t delta) -> std::int32_t {
  (*acc) = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>((*acc)) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(delta));
  return (*acc);
};
  std::int32_t first = [&]() { auto ply_fn1 = bump; auto ply_a2 = step; return ply_nonnull_fn(ply_fn1)(ply_a2); }();
  std::int32_t second = ply_nonnull_fn(double_acc)();
  return static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(first) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(second));
}

} // namespace closures_showcase
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_u32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  ply_u32 = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
End Function

Function ply_mul32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim ua, ub, al, ah, bl, bh, lo, md
  ua = ply_u32(a)
  ub = ply_u32(b)
  al = ua - Int(ua / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ah = Int(ua / 65536.0)
  bl = ub - Int(ub / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  bh = Int(ub / 65536.0)
  lo = al * bl
  md = ah * bl + al * bh
  md = md - Int(md / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ply_mul32 = ply_i32(lo + md * 65536.0)
End Function

Function ply_chk_null(ByVal o)
  If o Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  Set ply_chk_null = o
End Function

Class ply_Cell
  Public Val
End Class


Class ply_Clos_0
  Public c_0
  Public Function Invoke()
    c_0.Val = ply_mul32(c_0.Val, 2)
    Invoke = c_0.Val
    Exit Function
  End Function
End Class

Class ply_Clos_1
  Public c_0
  Public Function Invoke(ByVal delta)
    c_0.Val = ply_i32(CDbl(c_0.Val) + CDbl(delta))
    Invoke = c_0.Val
    Exit Function
  End Function
End Class


Function Run(ByVal start, ByVal step_v)
  Dim DoubleAcc, acc, bump, first, second_v, ply_fn1, ply_fn2, ply_cfn3, ply_ca4, ply_ir5, ply_cfn6, ply_ir7
  Set DoubleAcc = Nothing
  Set acc = New ply_Cell

  Set ply_fn1.c_0 = acc
  Set DoubleAcc = ply_fn1
  Set ply_fn2 = New ply_Clos_1
  Set ply_fn2.c_0 = acc
  Set bump = ply_fn2
  Set ply_cfn3 = bump
  ply_ca4 = step_v
  Set ply_cfn3 = ply_chk_null(ply_cfn3)

  second_v = ply_ir7
  Run = ply_i32(CDbl(first) + CDbl(second_v))
```

## Callbacks & Delegates

Higher-order functions accepting Func<T, T> and custom delegates via lambdas and method groups. Source: [`10-callbacks-and-delegates.cs`](showcase/10-callbacks-and-delegates.cs).

```csharp
using System;

public delegate int IntTransform(int value);

public static class CallbacksShowcase {
  private static int Square(int x) => x * x;

  private static int ApplyTwice(int value, IntTransform transform)
    => transform(transform(value));

  private static int MapSum(int[] values, Func<int, int> mapper) {
    int sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; ++i)
      sum += mapper(values[i]);
    return sum;
  }

  public static int Run(int[] values, int seed)
    => ApplyTwice(seed, Square) + MapSum(values, x => x + 1);
}
```

```rust
fn square(x: i32) -> i32 {
    x.wrapping_mul(x)
}

pub fn run(values: &[i32], seed: i32) -> i32 {
    let apply_twice_bound: i32 = square(square(seed));
    let sum: i32 = values
        .iter()
        .map(|&x| x.wrapping_add(1))
        .fold(0i32, |acc, x| acc.wrapping_add(x));
    apply_twice_bound.wrapping_add(sum)
}
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_u32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  ply_u32 = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
End Function

Function ply_mul32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim ua, ub, al, ah, bl, bh, lo, md
  ua = ply_u32(a)
  ub = ply_u32(b)
  al = ua - Int(ua / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ah = Int(ua / 65536.0)
  bl = ub - Int(ub / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  bh = Int(ub / 65536.0)
  lo = al * bl
  md = ah * bl + al * bh
  md = md - Int(md / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ply_mul32 = ply_i32(lo + md * 65536.0)
End Function

Sub ply_chk_idx(ByRef a, ByVal i)
  If IsNull(a) Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  If i < 0 Or i > UBound(a) Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1003, "IndexOutOfRangeException", "Index was outside the bounds of the array."
End Sub


Function Square(ByVal x)
  Square = ply_mul32(x, x)
  Exit Function
End Function

Function Run(ByRef values, ByVal seed)
  Dim value, applyTwice_Bound, values2, sum, i, mapSum_Bound, x, run_Lambda
  applyTwice_Bound = Square(Square(seed))
  sum = 0
  i = 0
  Do While ((i) < ((UBound(values) + 1)))
    Call ply_chk_idx(values, i)
    x = values(i)
    sum = ply_i32(CDbl(sum) + CDbl(ply_i32(CDbl(x) + CDbl(1))))
    i = ply_i32(CDbl(i) + CDbl(1))
  Loop
  Run = ply_i32(CDbl(applyTwice_Bound) + CDbl(sum))
  Exit Function
End Function
```

```kotlin
// CallbacksShowcase: generated by polypiler. Change the source, not this file.
// Kotlin profile: kotlin2.0, JVM target 1.8.

package callbacksshowcase

private fun square(x: Int): Int = x * x

fun run_(values: IntArray, seed: Int): Int {
    val applyTwiceBound: Int = square(square(seed))
    var sum: Int = 0
    var i: Int = 0
    while (i < values.size) {
        val x: Int = values[i]
        sum += x + 1
        i += 1
    }
    return applyTwiceBound + sum
}
```

## Enums & Nullable Optionals

Flags enum bit operations and nullable scalar types with null-coalescing and lifted arithmetic. Source: [`11-enums-and-optionals.cs`](showcase/11-enums-and-optionals.cs).

```csharp
using System;

[Flags]
public enum Permissions {
  None = 0,
  Read = 1,
  Write = 2,
  Execute = 4
}

public static class EnumsAndOptionalsShowcase {
  public static int Resolve(Permissions flags, int? overrideValue) {
    int baseScore = flags.HasFlag(Permissions.Write) ? 10 : 1;
    int? adjusted = overrideValue + baseScore;
    return adjusted ?? baseScore;
  }
}
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Const Permissions_None = 0
Const Permissions_Read = 1
Const Permissions_Write_v = 2
Const Permissions_Execute_v = 4

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_and32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  ply_and32 = ply_i32(a) And ply_i32(b)
End Function


Function Resolve(ByVal flags, ByVal overrideValue)
```

## Collections

List<T>, Dictionary<TKey, TValue>, and HashSet<T> mutations, lookups, and iteration. Source: [`12-collections.cs`](showcase/12-collections.cs).

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

public static class CollectionsShowcase {
  public static int Run(int[] values) {
    var list = new List<int>();
    var seen = new HashSet<int>();
    var counts = new Dictionary<string, int>();

    foreach (var v in values) {
      if (seen.Add(v))
        list.Add(v);
      string bucket = v >= 0 ? "pos" : "neg";
      if (counts.TryGetValue(bucket, out var current))
        counts[bucket] = current + 1;
      else
        counts.Add(bucket, 1);
    }

    int pos = 0;
    if (counts.TryGetValue("pos", out var p))
      pos = p;
    return list.Count * 10 + pos;
  }
}
```

```rust
fn ply_map_add<K: PartialEq, V>(map: &mut Vec<Result<(K, V), u32>>, key: K, value: V) {
    if ply_map_find(map, &key).is_some() {
        panic!("DuplicateKey");
    }
    ply_slot_insert(map, (key, value));
}

fn ply_map_find<K: PartialEq, V>(map: &[Result<(K, V), u32>], key: &K) -> Option<usize> {
    map.iter()
        .position(|slot| slot.as_ref().ok().map(|entry| &entry.0) == Some(key))
}

fn ply_map_get<K: PartialEq, V: Clone>(map: &[Result<(K, V), u32>], key: &K) -> Option<V> {
    ply_map_find(map, key)
        .and_then(|at| map[at].as_ref().ok())
        .map(|entry| entry.1.clone())
}

fn ply_map_put<K: PartialEq, V>(map: &mut Vec<Result<(K, V), u32>>, key: K, value: V) {
    let found = ply_map_find(map, &key);
    match found {
        Some(at) => map[at] = Ok((key, value)),
        None => ply_slot_insert(map, (key, value)),
    }
}

fn ply_set_add<T: PartialEq>(set: &mut Vec<Result<T, u32>>, element: T) -> bool {
    if ply_set_find(set, &element).is_some() {
        return false;
    }
    ply_slot_insert(set, element);
    true
}

fn ply_set_find<T: PartialEq>(set: &[Result<T, u32>], element: &T) -> Option<usize> {
    set.iter()
        .position(|slot| slot.as_ref().ok() == Some(element))
}

fn ply_slot_freed<T>(slots: &[Result<T, u32>]) -> Option<usize> {
    let newest = slots.iter().filter_map(|slot| slot.as_ref().err()).max();
    slots
        .iter()
        .position(|slot| newest.is_some() && slot.as_ref().err() == newest)
}

fn ply_slot_insert<T>(slots: &mut Vec<Result<T, u32>>, entry: T) {
    match ply_slot_freed(slots) {
        Some(at) => slots[at] = Ok(entry),
        None => slots.push(Ok(entry)),
    }
}

fn ply_utf16(text: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
    text.encode_utf16().collect()
}

pub fn run(values: &[i32]) -> i32 {
    let mut list: Vec<i32> = Vec::new();
    let mut seen: Vec<Result<i32, u32>> = Vec::new();
    let mut counts: Vec<Result<(Vec<u16>, i32), u32>> = Vec::new();
    for &v in values {
        if ply_set_add(&mut seen, v) {
            list.push(v);
        }
        let bucket: Vec<u16> = if v >= 0 {
            ply_utf16("pos")
        } else {
            ply_utf16("neg")
        };
        let current: i32;
        if ply_map_find(&counts, &bucket).is_some() {
            current = ply_map_get(&counts, &bucket).expect("KeyNotFound");
            ply_map_put(&mut counts, bucket.clone(), current.wrapping_add(1));
        } else {
            current = 0;
            ply_map_add(&mut counts, bucket.clone(), 1);
        }
    }
    let mut pos: i32 = 0;
    let t8: Vec<u16> = ply_utf16("pos");
    let p: i32;
    if ply_map_find(&counts, &t8).is_some() {
        p = ply_map_get(&counts, &t8).expect("KeyNotFound");
        pos = p;
    } else {
        p = 0;
    }
    (list.len() as i32).wrapping_mul(10).wrapping_add(pos)
}
```

```cpp
#include "collections_showcase.hpp"
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>

namespace collections_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename K, typename V, bool SlotReuse>
struct PlyMap {
  struct Entry {
    bool occupied = false;
    K key{};
    V value{};
  };

  std::vector<Entry> entries{};
  std::vector<std::size_t> free_list{};
  std::size_t count_ = 0;

  static bool key_eq(const K& a, const K& b) {
    if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<K>)
      return (a == b) || (std::isnan(a) && std::isnan(b));
    else
      return a == b;
  }

  std::size_t find_slot(const K& key) const {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < this->entries.size(); ++i)
      if (this->entries[i].occupied && key_eq(this->entries[i].key, key))
        return i;
    return static_cast<std::size_t>(-1);
  }

  std::int32_t count() const { return static_cast<std::int32_t>(this->count_); }

  bool contains_key(const K& key) const { return this->find_slot(key) != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1); }

  V& get(const K& key) {
    const auto slot = this->find_slot(key);
    if (slot == static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))
      throw std::out_of_range("key not found");
    return this->entries[slot].value;
  }

  const V& get(const K& key) const {
    const auto slot = this->find_slot(key);
    if (slot == static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))
      throw std::out_of_range("key not found");
    return this->entries[slot].value;
  }

  std::optional<V> try_get_opt(const K& key) const {

  }

template <typename K, bool SlotReuse>
struct PlySet {
  struct Entry {
    bool occupied = false;
    K key{};
  };

  std::vector<Entry> entries{};
  std::vector<std::size_t> free_list{};
  std::size_t count_ = 0;

  static bool key_eq(const K& a, const K& b) {
    if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<K>)
      return (a == b) || (std::isnan(a) && std::isnan(b));
    else
      return a == b;
  }

  std::size_t find_slot(const K& key) const {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < this->entries.size(); ++i)
      if (this->entries[i].occupied && key_eq(this->entries[i].key, key))
        return i;
    return static_cast<std::size_t>(-1);
  }

  std::int32_t count() const { return static_cast<std::int32_t>(this->count_); }

  bool contains(const K& key) const { return this->find_slot(key) != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1); }

  bool add(const K& key) {
    if (this->find_slot(key) != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))
      return false;
    if constexpr (SlotReuse) {
      if (!this->free_list.empty()) {
        const auto slot = this->free_list.back();
        this->free_list.pop_back();
        this->entries[slot] = Entry{true, key};
        ++this->count_;
        return true;
      }
    }
    this->entries.push_back(Entry{true, key});
    ++this->count_;
    return true;
  }

  bool remove(const K& key) {
    const auto slot = this->find_slot(key);
    if (slot == static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))
      return false;
    this->entries[slot].occupied = false;
    this->entries[slot].key = K{};
    if constexpr (SlotReuse)
      this->free_list.push_back(slot);
    --this->count_;
    return true;
  }

  void clear() {
    this->entries.clear();
    this->free_list.clear();
    this->count_ = 0;
  }
};

}
```

## Iterators & Lazy Sequences

Restartable iterator methods with yield return and yield break consumed lazily via foreach. Source: [`13-iterators-and-yield.cs`](showcase/13-iterators-and-yield.cs).

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

public static class IteratorsShowcase {
  private static IEnumerable<int> EvensUpTo(int limit) {
    for (int i = 0; i <= limit; i += 2) {
      if (i > 100)
        yield break;
      yield return i;
    }
  }

  public static int SumEvens(int limit) {
    int sum = 0;
    foreach (var value in EvensUpTo(limit))
      sum += value;
    return sum;
  }
}
```

```rust
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct EvensUpTo {
    state: u32,
    limit: i32,
    i: i32,
}

impl Iterator for EvensUpTo {
    type Item = i32;

    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<i32> {
        loop {
            match self.state {
                0 => {
                    self.i = 0;
                    self.state = 1;
                }
                1 => {
                    if self.i > self.limit {
                        self.state = 4;
                        return None;
                    }
                    if self.i <= 100 {
                        self.state = 2;
                        continue;
                    }
                    self.state = 4;
                    return None;
                }
                2 => {
                    self.state = 3;
                    return Some(self.i);
                }
                3 => {
                    self.i = self.i.wrapping_add(2);
                    self.state = 1;
                }
                _ => return None,
            }
        }
    }
}

fn evens_up_to(limit: i32) -> EvensUpTo {
    EvensUpTo {
        state: 0,
        limit,
        i: 0,
    }
}

pub fn sum_evens(limit: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut sum: i32 = 0;
    for value in evens_up_to(limit) {
        sum = sum.wrapping_add(value);
    }
    sum
}
```

```cpp
static std::function<std::vector<std::int32_t>()> evens_up_to(std::int32_t);

static std::function<std::vector<std::int32_t>()> evens_up_to(std::int32_t limit) {
  return [ply_cap2 = limit]() -> std::vector<std::int32_t> {
    auto limit = ply_cap2;
    std::vector<std::int32_t> ply_seq1{};
    {
      std::int32_t i = 0;
      while ((i <= limit)) {
        if ((i > 100)) {
          return ply_seq1;
        }
        ply_seq1.push_back(i);
        i = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(2));
      }
    }
    return ply_seq1;
  };
}

std::int32_t sum_evens(std::int32_t limit) {
  std::int32_t sum = 0;
  for (std::int32_t value : (evens_up_to(limit))()) {
    sum = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(sum) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value));
  }
  return sum;
}
```

## LINQ

Deferred LINQ query pipelines combining Where, Select, Take, and Sum. Source: [`14-linq.cs`](showcase/14-linq.cs).

```csharp
using System.Linq;

public static class LinqShowcase {
  public static int TopSquaredSum(int[] values, int count)
    => values
      .Where(x => x > 0)
      .Select(x => x * x)
      .Take(count)
      .Sum();
}
```

```rust
pub fn top_squared_sum(values: &[i32], count: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut sum: i32 = 0;
    if count > 0 {
        let mut stop: bool = false;
        let mut i: i32 = 0;
        let mut n: i32 = 0;
        while i < values.len() as i32 {
            let x: i32 = values[i as usize];
            i = i.wrapping_add(1);
            if x > 0 {
                let y: i32 = x.wrapping_mul(x);
                n = n.wrapping_add(1);
                sum = sum.checked_add(y).expect("IntegerOverflow");
                if n >= count {
                    stop = true;
                }
            }
            if stop {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    sum
}
```

```cpp
#include "linq_showcase.hpp"
#include <cstddef>
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>

namespace linq_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename T>
T ply_checked_add(T a, T b) {
  if constexpr (std::is_signed_v<T>) {
    if ((b > 0 && a > std::numeric_limits<T>::max() - b) ||
        (b < 0 && a < std::numeric_limits<T>::min() - b))
      throw std::overflow_error("integer overflow");
    using U = std::make_unsigned_t<T>;
    return static_cast<T>(static_cast<U>(a) + static_cast<U>(b));
  } else {
    if (a > std::numeric_limits<T>::max() - b)
      throw std::overflow_error("integer overflow");
    return static_cast<T>(a + b);
  }
}

template <typename C>
auto ply_at(C& arr, std::int32_t index) -> decltype(arr[static_cast<std::size_t>(0)]) {
  if (index < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(index) >= arr.size())
    throw std::out_of_range("index out of range");
  return arr[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
}
template <typename C>
auto ply_at(const C& arr, std::int32_t index) -> decltype(arr[static_cast<std::size_t>(0)]) {
  if (index < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(index) >= arr.size())
    throw std::out_of_range("index out of range");
  return arr[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
}

} // namespace

std::int32_t top_squared_sum(const std::vector<std::int32_t>& values, std::int32_t count) {
  std::int32_t sum = 0;
  if ((!((count <= 0)))) {
    bool stop = false;
    std::int32_t i = 0;
    std::int32_t n = 0;
    while ((i < static_cast<std::int32_t>((values).size()))) {
      std::int32_t x = ply_at(values, i);
      i = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(1));
      if ((x > 0)) {
        std::int32_t y = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(x) * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(x));
        n = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(n) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(1));
        sum = ply_checked_add<std::int32_t>(sum, y);
        if ((n >= count)) {
          stop = true;
        }
      }
      if (stop) {
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return sum;
}

} // namespace linq_showcase
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_u32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  ply_u32 = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
End Function

Function ply_mul32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim ua, ub, al, ah, bl, bh, lo, md
  ua = ply_u32(a)
  ub = ply_u32(b)
  al = ua - Int(ua / 65536.0) * 65536.0
```

```kotlin
        var i: Int = 0

        while (i < values.size) {

                break
            }
        }
    }
```

## Exceptions & Resource Scopes

Custom exceptions, catch filters (when), finally cleanup, and deterministic IDisposable using scopes. Source: [`15-exceptions-and-using.cs`](showcase/15-exceptions-and-using.cs).

```csharp
using System;

public sealed class DomainException : Exception {
  public DomainException(string message) : base(message) { }
}

public sealed class ScopeTracker : IDisposable {
  public int Closed { get; private set; }
  public void Dispose() => this.Closed += 1;
}

public static class ExceptionsAndUsingShowcase {
  public static int Evaluate(int value) {
    var tracker = new ScopeTracker();
    int result = 0;
    try {
      using (tracker) {
        if (value < 0)
          throw new DomainException("negative");
        result = value * 2;
      }
    } catch (DomainException e) when (e.Message.Length > 0) {
      result = -1;
    } finally {
      result += tracker.Closed;
    }
    return result;
  }
}
```

## Tasks & Async/Await

Asynchronous Task<T> workflows using async/await, Task.FromResult, and Task.WhenAll. Source: [`16-tasks-and-async.cs`](showcase/16-tasks-and-async.cs).

```csharp
using System.Threading.Tasks;

public static class TasksShowcase {
  private static async Task<int> ComputeAsync(int x)
    => await Task.FromResult(x * x + 1);

  public static async Task<int> CombineAsync(int a, int b) {
    int[] parts = await Task.WhenAll(ComputeAsync(a), ComputeAsync(b));
    return parts[0] + parts[1];
  }
}
```

```cpp
#include "tasks_showcase.hpp"
#include <cstddef>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>

namespace tasks_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename C>
auto ply_at(C& arr, std::int32_t index) -> decltype(arr[static_cast<std::size_t>(0)]) {
  if (index < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(index) >= arr.size())
    throw std::out_of_range("index out of range");
  return arr[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
}
template <typename C>
auto ply_at(const C& arr, std::int32_t index) -> decltype(arr[static_cast<std::size_t>(0)]) {
  if (index < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(index) >= arr.size())
    throw std::out_of_range("index out of range");
  return arr[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
}

template <typename T>
PlyTask<std::vector<T>> ply_when_all_list(std::initializer_list<PlyTask<T>> tasks) {
  std::vector<T> out;
  out.reserve(tasks.size());
  for (const auto& t : tasks) {
    if (t.error_)
      return PlyTask<std::vector<T>>::from_exception(t.error_);
    out.push_back(*t.value_);
  }
  return PlyTask<std::vector<T>>::from_result(std::move(out));
}

inline PlyTask<void> ply_when_all_void(std::initializer_list<PlyTask<void>> tasks) {
  for (const auto& t : tasks) {
    if (t.error_)
      return PlyTask<void>::from_exception(t.error_);
  }
  return PlyTask<void>::completed();
}

} // namespace

static PlyTask<std::int32_t> compute_async(std::int32_t);

static PlyTask<std::int32_t> compute_async(std::int32_t x) {
  try {
    return PlyTask<std::int32_t>::from_result((PlyTask<std::int32_t>::from_result(static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(x) * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(x))) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(1)))).await());
  } catch (...) {
    return PlyTask<std::int32_t>::from_exception(std::current_exception());
  }
}

PlyTask<std::int32_t> combine_async(std::int32_t a, std::int32_t b) {
  try {
    std::vector<std::int32_t> parts = (ply_when_all_list<std::int32_t>({compute_async(a), compute_async(b)})).await();
    return PlyTask<std::int32_t>::from_result(static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ply_at(parts, 0)) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ply_at(parts, 1))));
  } catch (...) {
    return PlyTask<std::int32_t>::from_exception(std::current_exception());
  }
}

} // namespace tasks_showcase
```

```cpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <exception>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>

namespace tasks_showcase {

template <typename T>
struct PlyTask {
  std::optional<T> value_{};
  std::exception_ptr error_{};

  static PlyTask from_result(T value) {
    PlyTask task;
    task.value_ = std::move(value);
    return task;
  }

  static PlyTask from_exception(std::exception_ptr err) {
    PlyTask task;
    task.error_ = std::move(err);
    return task;
  }

  T await() const {
    if (this->error_)
      std::rethrow_exception(this->error_);
    return *this->value_;
  }
};

template <>
struct PlyTask<void> {
  std::exception_ptr error_{};

  static PlyTask completed() { return PlyTask{}; }

  static PlyTask from_exception(std::exception_ptr err) {
    PlyTask task;
    task.error_ = std::move(err);
    return task;
  }

  void await() const {
    if (this->error_)
      std::rethrow_exception(this->error_);
  }
};

PlyTask<std::int32_t> combine_async(std::int32_t a, std::int32_t b);

} // namespace tasks_showcase
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_u32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  ply_u32 = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
End Function

Function ply_mul32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim ua, ub, al, ah, bl, bh, lo, md
  ua = ply_u32(a)
  ub = ply_u32(b)
  al = ua - Int(ua / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ah = Int(ua / 65536.0)
  bl = ub - Int(ub / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  bh = Int(ub / 65536.0)
  lo = al * bl
  md = ah * bl + al * bh
  md = md - Int(md / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ply_mul32 = ply_i32(lo + md * 65536.0)
End Function

Sub ply_chk_idx(ByRef a, ByVal i)
  If IsNull(a) Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  If i < 0 Or i > UBound(a) Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1003, "IndexOutOfRangeException", "Index was outside the bounds of the array."
End Sub

Dim ply_last_err
Set ply_last_err = Nothing

Class ply_Exception
  Public ply_kind
  Public Message
  Public InnerException
  Public Function ply_is(ByVal t)
    If t = "Exception" Or t = ply_kind Then
      ply_is = True
      Exit Function
    End If
    If t = "ArithmeticException" And (ply_kind = "DivideByZeroException" Or ply_kind = "OverflowException") Then
      ply_is = True
      Exit Function
    End If
    If t = "ArgumentException" And ply_kind = "ArgumentOutOfRangeException" Then
      ply_is = True
      Exit Function
    End If
    ply_is = False
  End Function
End Class

Function ply_make_err(ByVal kind, ByVal msg, ByVal inner)
  Dim e
  Set e = New ply_Exception
  e.ply_kind = kind
  e.Message = msg
  Set e.InnerException = inner
  Set ply_make_err = e
End Function

Sub ply_throw(ByVal exObj)
  If exObj Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  Set ply_last_err = exObj
  Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1099, exObj.ply_kind, exObj.Message
End Sub

Function ply_capture_err(ByVal num, ByVal src, ByVal desc)
  Dim e, k
  If num = vbObjectError + 1099 And Not (ply_last_err Is Nothing) Then
    Set e = ply_last_err
    Set ply_last_err = Nothing
    Set ply_capture_err = e
    Exit Function
  End If
  If num = 11 Then
    k = "DivideByZeroException"
  ElseIf num = 6 Then
    k = "OverflowException"
  ElseIf num = 9 Then
    k = "IndexOutOfRangeException"
  ElseIf Len(src) > 0 Then
    k = src
  Else
    k = "Exception"
  End If
  Set ply_capture_err = ply_make_err(k, desc, Nothing)
End Function

Class ply_Task
  Public HasError
  Public ErrObj
  Public Result
  Private Sub Class_Initialize()
    HasError = False
    Set ErrObj = Nothing
    Result = Empty
  End Sub
End Class

Function ply_task_from_result(ByVal v)
  Dim t
  Set t = New ply_Task
  If IsObject(v) Then Set t.Result = v Else t.Result = v
  Set ply_task_from_result = t
End Function

Function ply_task_completed()
  Set ply_task_completed = New ply_Task
End Function

Function ply_task_fault(ByVal e)
  Dim t
  Set t = New ply_Task
  t.HasError = True
  Set t.ErrObj = e
  Set ply_task_fault = t
End Function

Function ply_task_await(ByVal t)
  If t Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  If t.HasError Then Call ply_throw(t.ErrObj)
  If IsObject(t.Result) Then Set ply_task_await = t.Result Else ply_task_await = t.Result
End Function

Sub ply_task_await_void(ByVal t)
  If t Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  If t.HasError Then Call ply_throw(t.ErrObj)
End Sub

Function ply_task_when_all(ByVal tasks, ByVal isVoid)
  Dim i, n, t, r()
  n = UBound(tasks) + 1
  For i = 0 To n - 1
    Set t = tasks(i)
    If t.HasError Then
      Set ply_task_when_all = ply_task_fault(t.ErrObj)
      Exit Function
    End If
  Next
  If isVoid Then
    Set ply_task_when_all = ply_task_completed()
    Exit Function
  End If
  If n = 0 Then
    Set ply_task_when_all = ply_task_from_result(Array())
    Exit Function
  End If
  ReDim r(n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
    Set t = tasks(i)
    If IsObject(t.Result) Then Set r(i) = t.Result Else r(i) = t.Result
  Next
  Set ply_task_when_all = ply_task_from_result(r)
End Function


Function ComputeAsync(ByVal x)
  Dim ply_an1, ply_as2, ply_ad3, ply_ar4
  On Error Resume Next
  Do
    ply_ar4 = ply_task_await(ply_task_from_result(ply_i32(CDbl(ply_mul32(x, x)) + CDbl(1))))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then Exit Do
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set ComputeAsync = ply_task_from_result(ply_ar4)
    Exit Function
  Loop Until True
  ply_an1 = Err.Number
  ply_as2 = Err.Source
  ply_ad3 = Err.Description
  Err.Clear
  On Error GoTo 0
  If ply_an1 <> 0 Then
    Set ComputeAsync = ply_task_fault(ply_capture_err(ply_an1, ply_as2, ply_ad3))
    Exit Function
  End If
  Set ComputeAsync = ply_task_completed()
End Function

Function CombineAsync(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim parts, ply_an1, ply_as2, ply_ad3, ply_wt4, ply_wt5, ply_l6, ply_ar7
  On Error Resume Next
  Do
    Set ply_wt4 = ComputeAsync(a)
    Set ply_wt5 = ComputeAsync(b)
    parts = ply_task_await(ply_task_when_all(Array(ply_wt4, ply_wt5), False))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then Exit Do
    Call ply_chk_idx(parts, 0)
    ply_l6 = parts(0)
    Call ply_chk_idx(parts, 1)
    ply_ar7 = ply_i32(CDbl(ply_l6) + CDbl(parts(1)))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then Exit Do
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set CombineAsync = ply_task_from_result(ply_ar7)
    Exit Function
  Loop Until True
  ply_an1 = Err.Number
  ply_as2 = Err.Source
  ply_ad3 = Err.Description
  Err.Clear
  On Error GoTo 0
  If ply_an1 <> 0 Then
    Set CombineAsync = ply_task_fault(ply_capture_err(ply_an1, ply_as2, ply_ad3))
    Exit Function
  End If
  Set CombineAsync = ply_task_completed()
End Function
```

```perl
use strict;
use warnings;
use Exporter 'import';
use Carp ();

our $VERSION = '0.001';
our @EXPORT_OK = qw(run);
BEGIN { die "StdioShowcase requires a perl with 64-bit integers\n" unless ~0 > 4294967295; }

sub run {
    use integer;
    @_ == 0 or Carp::croak('usage: run()');
    my $sum = 0;
    {
        my $i = 1;
        LOOP1: while ($i <= 3) {
            $sum = ((((($sum + ($i * $i))) & 0xFFFFFFFF) ^ 0x80000000) - 0x80000000);
            print(("step " . sprintf('%d', $i) . ": sum=" . sprintf('%d', $sum)), "\n");
            $i = ($i + 1);
        }
    }
    return $sum;
}

1;

__END__
```

```vbscript
Option Explicit

Function ply_i32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  m = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
  If m >= 2147483648.0 Then m = m - 4294967296.0
  ply_i32 = CLng(m)
End Function

Function ply_u32(ByVal x)
  Dim m
  m = CDbl(x)
  ply_u32 = m - Int(m / 4294967296.0) * 4294967296.0
End Function

Function ply_mul32(ByVal a, ByVal b)
  Dim ua, ub, al, ah, bl, bh, lo, md
  ua = ply_u32(a)
  ub = ply_u32(b)
  al = ua - Int(ua / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ah = Int(ua / 65536.0)
  bl = ub - Int(ub / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  bh = Int(ub / 65536.0)
  lo = al * bl
  md = ah * bl + al * bh
  md = md - Int(md / 65536.0) * 65536.0
  ply_mul32 = ply_i32(lo + md * 65536.0)
End Function


Function Run()
  Dim sum, i
  sum = 0
  i = 1
  Do While ((i) <= (3))
    sum = ply_i32(CDbl(sum) + CDbl(ply_mul32(i, i)))
    WScript.Echo ("step " & CStr(i) & ": sum=" & CStr(sum))
    i = ply_i32(CDbl(i) + CDbl(1))
  Loop
  Run = sum
  Exit Function
End Function
```

## Spans, Bit Permutations & Unsafe Pointers

Zero-copy ReadOnlySpan<int> slicing, bounded unsafe fixed pointers, and BMI2 bit extraction. Source: [`18-spans-and-pointers.cs`](showcase/18-spans-and-pointers.cs).

```csharp
using System;
using System.Runtime.Intrinsics.X86;

public static class LowLevelShowcase {
  public static uint ExtractBits(uint source, uint mask)
    => Bmi2.ParallelBitExtract(source, mask);

  public static unsafe int SumSlice(int[] data, int offset, int length) {
    ReadOnlySpan<int> view = data.AsSpan(offset, length);
    int total = 0;
    fixed (int* ptr = view) {
      for (int i = 0; i < view.Length; ++i)
        total += ptr[i];
    }
    return total;
  }
}
```

```rust
fn ply_pointer(at: i64, width: usize, size: usize, nullable: bool) -> std::ops::Range<usize> {
    if nullable && size == 0 {
        panic!("NullReference");
    }
    let start = usize::try_from(at).expect("IndexOutOfRange");
    if width > size || start > size - width {
        panic!("IndexOutOfRange");
    }
    start..start + width
}

    if start < 0 || length < 0 || start as usize + length as usize > source.len() {
        panic!("ArgumentOutOfRange");
    }
    &source[start as usize..start as usize + length as usize]
}

fn parallel_bit_extract32(value: u32, mask: u32, bits: i32) -> u32 {
    let mut m: u32 = if bits == 32 {

        mask & 1u32.wrapping_shl(bits as u32).wrapping_sub(1)
```

```cpp
#include "low_level_showcase.hpp"
#include <cstddef>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <type_traits>

namespace low_level_showcase {

namespace {

template <typename T>
struct PlySpan {
  T* data_ = nullptr;
  std::size_t size_ = 0;

  PlySpan() = default;
  PlySpan(T* data, std::size_t size) : data_(data), size_(size) {}
  template <typename U, typename = std::enable_if_t<std::is_convertible_v<U (*)[], T (*)[]>>>
  PlySpan(std::vector<U>& vec) : data_(vec.data()), size_(vec.size()) {}
  template <typename U, typename = std::enable_if_t<std::is_convertible_v<const U (*)[], T (*)[]>>>
  PlySpan(const std::vector<U>& vec) : data_(vec.data()), size_(vec.size()) {}
  template <typename U, typename = std::enable_if_t<std::is_convertible_v<U (*)[], T (*)[]>>>
  PlySpan(const PlySpan<U>& other) : data_(other.data()), size_(other.size()) {}

  T* data() const { return this->data_; }
  std::size_t size() const { return this->size_; }
  bool empty() const { return this->size_ == 0; }
  T* begin() const { return this->data_; }
  T* end() const { return this->data_ + this->size_; }
  T& operator[](std::size_t index) const { return this->data_[index]; }
  PlySpan subspan(std::size_t offset, std::size_t count) const { return PlySpan(this->data_ + offset, count); }
};

template <typename T>
T ply_pext(T source, T mask) {
  using U = std::make_unsigned_t<T>;
  const U src = static_cast<U>(source);
  U m = static_cast<U>(mask);
  U res = 0;
  U bit = 1;
  while (m != 0) {
    const U lsb = m & static_cast<U>(U{0} - m);
    if ((src & lsb) != 0)
      res |= bit;
    m ^= lsb;
    bit <<= 1;
  }
  return static_cast<T>(res);
}

template <typename SpanT, typename Src>
SpanT ply_view_of(Src&& src) {
  using Elem = std::remove_pointer_t<decltype(SpanT{}.data())>;
  return SpanT(const_cast<Elem*>(src.data()), src.size());
}
template <typename SpanT, typename Src>
SpanT ply_view_of(Src&& src, std::int32_t start) {
  if (start < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(start) > src.size())
    throw std::out_of_range("slice out of range");
  using Elem = std::remove_pointer_t<decltype(SpanT{}.data())>;
  const auto s = static_cast<std::size_t>(start);
  return SpanT(const_cast<Elem*>(src.data()) + s, src.size() - s);
}
template <typename SpanT, typename Src>
SpanT ply_view_of(Src&& src, std::int32_t start, std::int32_t length) {
  if (start < 0 || length < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(start) + static_cast<std::size_t>(length) > src.size())
    throw std::out_of_range("slice out of range");
  using Elem = std::remove_pointer_t<decltype(SpanT{}.data())>;
  return SpanT(const_cast<Elem*>(src.data()) + static_cast<std::size_t>(start), static_cast<std::size_t>(length));
}

template <typename T, typename Src>
T* ply_pin(Src&& src) {
  return src.empty() ? nullptr : const_cast<T*>(src.data());
}
template <typename T, typename Src>
T* ply_pin(Src&& src, std::int32_t index) {
  if (index < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(index) >= src.size())
    throw std::out_of_range("index out of range");
  return const_cast<T*>(src.data() + static_cast<std::size_t>(index));
}

template <typename T>
T ply_ptr_load(const T* ptr) {
  if (ptr == nullptr)
    throw std::runtime_error("null reference");
  return *ptr;
}

template <typename T>
T* ply_ptr_add(T* ptr, std::int32_t offset) {
  return offset == 0 ? ptr : ptr + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset);
}

} // namespace

std::uint32_t extract_bits(std::uint32_t source, std::uint32_t mask) {
  return ply_pext<std::uint32_t>(source, mask);
}

std::int32_t sum_slice(const std::vector<std::int32_t>& data, std::int32_t offset, std::int32_t length) {
  PlySpan<const std::int32_t> view = ply_view_of<PlySpan<const std::int32_t>>(ply_view_of<PlySpan<std::int32_t>>(data, offset, length));
  std::int32_t total = 0;
  {
    std::int32_t* ptr = ply_pin<std::int32_t>(view);
    {
      std::int32_t i = 0;
      while ((i < static_cast<std::int32_t>((view).size()))) {
        total = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(total) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ply_ptr_load(ply_ptr_add(ptr, i))));
        i = static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i) + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(1));
      }
    }
  }
  return total;
}

} // namespace low_level_showcase
```

```vbscript
  Set s = New ply_Span
  s.ElemKind = elemKind
  s.ElemSize = elemSize

End Function

Function ply_span_from_buf(ByVal buf, ByVal startIdx, ByVal count)
  Dim c, s

    Set ply_span_from_buf = ply_span_empty(buf.ElemKind, buf.ElemSize)
    Exit Function
  End If
  If count < 0 Then c = buf.Length - startIdx Else c = count
  If startIdx < 0 Or c < 0 Or startIdx + c > buf.Length Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1003, "ArgumentOutOfRangeException", "Span range was out of bounds."
  Set s = New ply_Span
  Set s.Buf = buf
  s.ByteOffset = CDbl(startIdx) * CDbl(buf.ElemSize)
  s.Length = CLng(c)
  s.ElemKind = buf.ElemKind
  s.ElemSize = buf.ElemSize
  Set ply_span_from_buf = s
End Function

Function ply_span_from_arr(ByRef arr, ByVal elemKind, ByVal elemSize, ByVal startIdx, ByVal count)

End Function

End Function

Function ply_span_load_e(ByVal sp, ByVal at, ByVal width, ByVal isLittle, ByVal isSigned)
  Dim i, bi, acc
  If at < 0 Or at + width > sp.Length Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1003, "ArgumentOutOfRangeException", "Index was out of range."
  acc = 0.0
  For i = 0 To width - 1
    If isLittle Then bi = at + i Else bi = at + width - 1 - i
    acc = acc + CDbl(sp.GetAt(bi)) * (256.0 ^ i)
  Next
  If isSigned Then
    If width = 2 Then ply_span_load_e = ply_i16(acc) Else ply_span_load_e = ply_i32(acc)
  Else
    ply_span_load_e = acc
  End If
End Function

Sub ply_span_store_e(ByVal sp, ByVal at, ByVal val, ByVal width, ByVal isLittle)
  Dim i, bi, u
  If at < 0 Or at + width > sp.Length Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1003, "ArgumentOutOfRangeException", "Index was out of range."
  u = ply_u32(val)
  For i = 0 To width - 1
    If isLittle Then bi = at + i Else bi = at + width - 1 - i
    Call sp.SetAt(bi, CLng(u - Int(u / 256.0) * 256.0))
    u = Int(u / 256.0)
  Next
End Sub

Function ply_ptr_pin_span(ByVal sp, ByVal hasIdx, ByVal idx)

Function ply_ptr_pin_arr(ByRef arr, ByVal elemKind, ByVal elemSize, ByVal hasIdx, ByVal idx)

Function ply_ptr_add(ByVal p, ByVal delta, ByVal elemSize)

  If p Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."

Sub ply_ptr_store(ByVal p, ByVal v, ByVal elemKind, ByVal elemSize)
  If p Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  If p.Buf Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1004, "NullReferenceException", "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
  If p.Offset < 0 Or p.Offset > p.RegionBytes - CDbl(elemSize) Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1003, "IndexOutOfRangeException", "Index was outside the bounds of the pointer region."

  If b Is Nothing Then Set bb = Nothing Else Set bb = b.Buf

End Function

Function ply_ptr_pos(ByVal p)

Function ply_ptr_eq(ByVal a, ByVal b)

Function ply_ptr_cmp(ByVal a, ByVal b)

Function ply_ptr_diff(ByVal a, ByVal b, ByVal elemSize)

End Function
```

```cpp
struct NativePoint {
  std::int32_t x{};
  std::int32_t y{};

  bool operator==(const NativePoint& other) const {
    return (this->x == other.x) && (this->y == other.y);
  }
  bool operator!=(const NativePoint& other) const { return !(*this == other); }
};

} // namespace native_interop_showcase
```

```csharp
using System.Numerics;

public static class SimdVectorizationBoundary {
  public static int SumVector(int[] data) {
    var acc = Vector<int>.Zero;
    for (int i = 0; i <= data.Length - Vector<int>.Count; i += Vector<int>.Count)
      acc += new Vector<int>(data, i);
    return Vector.Sum(acc);
  }
}
```
